learner_operation: Reduce a rank-one consistent augmented 2x2 matrix to normalized REF, or read an already reduced matrix, then where requested express its general solution using one free variable.

fixed_features.feature: Rank-one consistent 2x2 system, first variable basic and second free.
fixed_features.justification: Target source questions and Introduction tutorial 0c91df0b-40c7-5a65-9fda-5d2d6438dfa3 focus on this fragment. Neighboring inconsistency is a separate KP; changing rank or pivot column would broaden scope.

fixed_features.feature: Five mathematical radio choices and original requested operation family.
fixed_features.justification: All 16 target banks use five mathematical choices: REF-only, solution from REF, or reduction then solution. Duplicate unkeyed q-42156 field is captured duplication, not a second learner task.

fixed_features.feature: Small captured coefficient magnitudes and row multipliers; finite signed-column/RHS domain.
fixed_features.justification: Keeps normalization/elimination arithmetic and workload comparable. Numeric magnitude is incidental, so this is a conservative bounded practice domain, not a claim to cover arbitrary singular systems. Independent signs, constants and matching candidate assignments do vary.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Changing RHS changes intercept; changing second coefficient column changes slope without new prerequisites.
answer_roles.observed: Fresh ±4 and interior scales, both column signs; explicit isolated-slope pairs pass math, native stale-answer rejection and actual rendering.

answer_roles.role: Which of five candidate matrices or solution families matches the prompt
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Any candidate may qualify while the visible bank stays fixed; position and bank frequency have no instructional meaning.
answer_roles.observed: 16 independently tested profiles each produce all five targets for the same bank. Previous modal-row/sign strategy no longer solves original minimal pair or runner batch.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Nonzero redundant-row rescaling must preserve the requested general solution.
answer_roles.observed: q-20963 versus q-73740 changes multiplier 8 to -5; normalized first row and solution agree, and both actual renderings/native classifications are correct.

coverage.case: Complete source banks and supported operations
coverage.result: 16/16 complete keyed banks, prompts, solutions and correct values replay; q-42156 duplicated unkeyed field resolved explicitly.

coverage.case: Fresh signs, boundaries, restored profiles and five eligible targets
coverage.result: 48 explicit boundary/interior records, 24 fresh random batch records and 80 controlled targets. All three operation families covered; 181 total records pass independent math.

coverage.case: Exact runner batch separately from controls
coverage.result: All 5 survive delivery. Four recognizable profiles, both RHS signs and column signs, 3 authored target positions. Prior bank-only rule solves 0/5; no tested surface strategy solves all 5.

counterfactuals.change: Hold bank, RHS and first column fixed; reverse second coefficient-column sign in q-42156, q-73743 and q-20962. Also test every target of a fixed bank in all profiles.
counterfactuals.expected: Normalized coefficient/affine slope, correct choice and all dependent explanations change coherently. Old matching candidate becomes wrong.
counterfactuals.observed: Exact math correct; before/after true responses accepted and stale alternatives rejected by native grader. Actual UI renders show changed coefficient and solution signs; every profile has five distinct prompt/solution/key triples for an identical bank.
counterfactuals.justification: The lesson derives the basic variable from the given equation; coefficients must determine the response rather than bank statistics.

counterfactuals.change: Keep first row and solution fixed while changing dependent second-row multiplier from 8 to -5 (q-20963 to q-73740), using same sign/RHS transformations and bank seed.
counterfactuals.expected: Prompt second row and elimination operation change, but normalized equation and general solution remain equivalent.
counterfactuals.observed: Both matrices have identical RREF and independently equivalent correct families. Actual UI screenshots show the different redundant rows and row operations with the same final solution; native grader accepts those solutions and rejects each wrong candidate in both banks.
counterfactuals.justification: Introduction tutorial removes the redundant zero equation; a nonzero scaling of a dependent equation cannot change the solution set.
